test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a substitute for the underlined group of words.

Kajal has an __inclination__ for history.
solution: The correct answer is **'Aptitude'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Inclination**" in this context refers to a natural tendency or liking towards something. **(झुकाव, एक विशेष रीति से कुछ करना चाहने की भावना; रुझान)** • When someone has an inclination for a particular subject, it means they have a natural interest or preference for it. • **Example**- He did not show the slightest **inclination **to help. • "**aptitude**" refers to a natural ability or talent for a particular activity or subject.(**अभिक्षमता**) • Example- She has an **aptitude **for learning languages. Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 2'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Altitude **refers to the height of something above sea level. (**समुद्र तल से ऊँचाई**) • **Attitude **refers to the way that you think, feel or behave.** (सोचने, अनुभव करने का तरीक़ा विशेष; रुख़, अभिवृत्ति, मनोवृत्ति, दृष्टिकोण)** • **Adoptive **relates to the act of adopting or choosing something, such as an adoptive parent or adoptive country. **(गोद लेने योग्य)** 116:Tbee, The correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
